en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Ali Bin Al Hakam Bin Miskeen, from Amro Bin Abu Nasr who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The people of the wilderness are swooping upon us, and among them are the Jews, and the Christians, and the Magians, so can we give charity to them?’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from ‘Amr ibn abu Nasr who has said the following:
“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘People who live in wilderness come to us. Among them are Jews, Christian and Zoroastrians. Can we give them charity?’ The Imam replied, ‘Yes, you
